name: turret
brief: Hull Turret: a robot gun bolted to the outside of the enemy carrier's hull. Tracks players crossing open space and fires slow heavy shells, leading them; its eye is a big searchlight that sweeps the sky and locks on. Reads at 50-200 m as a dark silhouette with a bright eye: a squat armoured drum base, a yoke, a head that pitches with a stubby twin cannon and a big round searchlight lens. Carrier palette: blue-grey paint, hazard yellow, gunmetal; warm white lens, red status lights. Weak spot: a magenta coolant core caged in a housing at the back of the base, hidden from the front.
